description: This file serves as the server entry point for a Remix application, handling server-side rendering, request handling, and response streaming based on client type (bot or browser).

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main function that processes incoming requests, determines if the client is a bot or browser, and delegates to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server rendering when the requester is a bot, streaming the response.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server rendering for browser clients, streaming the response.
